questions.question: Who is currently top of the Premier League table today, Sunday 25th Oct 2026?
questions.clue: The side currently occupying top spot plays their home fixtures at the Etihad Stadium.
questions.funFact: The leaders went into this weekend having scored more open-play goals than any other side in the division this season.

questions.question: Which Hungarian Liverpool midfielder celebrates his birthday today?
questions.clue: He captained his country at Euro 2024 and scored a famous long-range rocket against Leicester City in his debut season in England.
questions.funFact: Born on October 25, 2000, he inherited Liverpool's iconic number 8 shirt previously worn by Steven Gerrard.

questions.question: Who is the current manager of Crystal Palace?
questions.clue: He shares his first name with former Arsenal legend Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang.
questions.funFact: He built his managerial reputation in France by leading Olympique Lyonnais from the relegation zone to European qualification before moving to England.

questions.question: Saturday’s late Premier League match was Chelsea v Tottenham; what was the final score?
questions.clue: The visiting side kept a clean sheet while scoring twice in the second half.
questions.funFact: Spurs secured all three points at Stamford Bridge despite the home side dominating possession throughout the match.

questions.question: And in the same match which Chelsea player was sent off in the 80th minute for two bookable offences?
questions.clue: This England international playmaker famous for his "cold" celebration received two yellow cards in quick succession late in the game.
questions.funFact: This marked the very first red card of his professional Premier League career.

questions.question: Which team did Claudio Ranieri manage immediately prior to taking over at Leicester City in 2015?
questions.clue: It was an international team, not an English domestic club.
questions.funFact: Ranieri was sacked by Greece following an embarrassing defeat to the Faroe Islands right before getting the Leicester job.

questions.question: Manchester United legendary midfielder Eric Cantona wore which squad number?
questions.clue: This famous squad number was also worn by Manchester United legends George Best, David Beckham, and Cristiano Ronaldo.
questions.funFact: He famously turned up his collar whenever he stepped onto the pitch wearing this iconic jersey.

questions.question: Out of all of the football clubs that have played in the Premier League, which one has the smallest seating capacity?
questions.clue: Their home ground, Kenilworth Road, has the smallest stadium capacity in Premier League history.
questions.funFact: Kenilworth Road holds just over 11,000 spectators, making its away entrance famously pass through a row of terraced houses!

questions.question: How many Premier League titles has birthday boy Dominik Szoboszlai won during his Liverpool career?
questions.clue: The number of Premier League titles he has won so far is the lowest positive whole number.
questions.funFact: He helped Liverpool lift major domestic silverware during his debut campaign in English football.

questions.question: Peter Crouch started or featured for how many different Premier League clubs during his career?
questions.clue: It is an odd single-digit number higher than 5.
questions.funFact: He represented Aston Villa, Southampton, Liverpool, Portsmouth, Tottenham Hotspur, Stoke City, and Burnley in the top flight.
